capture.classification: Target-filtered metadata graph from application root. Ignore dev edges. Build edges and proc-macro crates, plus their transitive dependencies, are compile_tool paths. Other normal edges are code_candidate paths, not proof of bytes in the executable. Workspace feature unification and host/target metadata limitations can overinclude.
capture.review_process: Capture immutable locked target graphs, review every source and package handling entry, preserve full original bytes, then freeze input hashes. Repository frozen text uses focused Git attributes. Original vendor inputs use -text to preserve exact bytes across checkouts; other maintained frozen text uses eol=lf. Generated notice artifacts preserve original source bytes without Git text conversion.
